name: Timo Bernhard
features: fair skin, short blond hair, narrow features, lean build, composed expression
bio: Porsche through and through. World champion in 2015 and again in 2017, and a Le Mans winner with two marques — Audi in 2010, Porsche in 2017. In 2018 he took the 919 Hybrid Evo round the Nordschleife in 5:19.55, the fastest lap anyone has ever driven there.
